Subject: POC overnight soak - request for surge bucket/top-up

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for spinning up the trial environment for our recommendation engine POC. We completed a quick daytime run and saw promising latency numbers, but we need to run an overnight latency/throughput soak to validate tail behavior and warm-cache effects.

Request: could Redwood provision a temporary "surge bucket" for the night of Nov 27 (11:00 PM PST to 5:00 AM PST) so we can run a 6-hour soak at ~60 rps? Based on our estimates (attached), that equates to ~150k tokens total and a handful of large-context shots that will exercise KV caching.

Attachments: lumenlogix_poc_plan.pdf; load-test-metrics.csv (sample traces).

We want a short-term soft-topup (non-billable promo if possible) with an automatic rollback to our trial quotas after the window. Happy to sign an MSA addendum or acceptance of usage terms.

Can you confirm feasibility and any guardrails we should set?

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Senior ML Eng, LumenLogix

Hi Priya — reviewed your plan and sample traces. Short answer: feasible. More details: 

Load assumptions
- Target window: 2026-11-27 23:00 PST -> 2026-11-28 05:00 PST (6 hours)
- Profile: 60 rps sustained, up to 220 rps 30s spikes when we replay the burst trace
- Avg tokens per request: ~45, high-tail ~420 (few long-chats)
- Estimated total tokens: ~150,000 (buffered to 180k to be safe)

Options we can offer
1) Promo token top-up: add 180,000 tokens to the trial for the specified window; automatic rollback at 05:30 PST; hard cap enforcement and alert to you and the AE.
2) Temporary dedicated throughput slot: reserve a small pool (1-2 GPUs) for the 6-hour window — recommended if you need consistent tail latency under 100ms P50. Requires early notice and Ops coordination.
3) Model-fallback policy: configure automatic fallback to a smaller quantized variant if the token bucket is exhausted to avoid hard failures (we can enable with 95% probability to keep quality high).

My recommendation: Promo top-up (option 1) + fallback policy. We can set an automatic token drain at 05:30 and upload logs to your Drive link. If you want hard SLO guarantees, choose option 2 and I will open an Ops ticket.

Requested from Sales: approval to apply a one-off 180,000 token promo (non-billable) tied to DEAL-4421-LLX for the overnight soak; set cap and rollback; notify customer and provide runbook.

Attachment: sre-checklist.docx (runs / checks we will perform before 23:00 PST).

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
